remarks: This completely renovated first apartment offers the perfect balance of comfort, style, and location. Featuring a private front entrance, the home includes two well-proportioned bedrooms plus a beautiful new bathroom. The brand-new kitchen is outfitted with stainless steel appliances and opens to a generous sized living room. Additional highlights include central air conditioning, freshly painted, new flooring, a private washer and dryer (in the lower level), assigned off-street parking, and access to shared green space. Just minutes to the beach, ice skating, and the park, with an exceptional commuter-friendly location-this home delivers both convenience and everyday ease.
